title: Preliminary Testing of Cafe Move for Primary Prevention of Physical Frailty
official: Cafe Move: A Novel Program for Prevention of Age-Related Physical Frailty
summary: This project explores a novel means of health promotion and prevention of age-related physical frailty, which is designed to overcome barriers to access and promote autonomy in managing physical health.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Legally autonomous to consent
* Lives independently
* Ability to sit, stand, and walk without the assistance of another person

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not legally autonomous to consent
* Institutionalized
